#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -Eeuo pipefail

script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
artifact_root="$(cd "${script_dir}/../.." && pwd)"
opensource_root=${OPENSOURCE_ROOT:-/root/autodl-tmp/HybridKV-artifact/HybridKV-opensource}
run_tag=${RUN_TAG:-formal_limit200_20260721}
limit=${LIMIT:-200}

if [[ "${limit}" != "200" ]]; then
  echo "[FullKV-200] This formal queue requires LIMIT=200, got ${limit}" >&2
  exit 2
fi

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate hybridkv

export PATH="/root/miniconda3/envs/hybridkv/lib/jvm/bin:${PATH}"
export HF_HOME=${HF_HOME:-${artifact_root}/scripts/data/huggingface_cache}
export HF_DATASETS_CACHE=${HF_DATASETS_CACHE:-${HF_HOME}/datasets}
export HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE=${HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE:-${HF_HOME}/hub}
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=${HF_HUB_OFFLINE:-1}
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=${TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE:-1}
export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=${HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE:-1}
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0}
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=${OMP_NUM_THREADS:-4}
export DECORD_EOF_RETRY_MAX=${DECORD_EOF_RETRY_MAX:-20480}
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export NLTK_DATA=${NLTK_DATA:-/root/nltk_data}

gpu_memory=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i 0 | awk 'NR == 1 {print $1}')
if [[ "${FORCE_RUN:-0}" != "1" && "${gpu_memory}" -gt 2048 ]]; then
  echo "[FullKV-200] GPU is busy: memory.used=${gpu_memory} MiB" >&2
  exit 3
fi

validate_result() {
  local task=$1
  local run_dir=$2
  python - "${task}" "${run_dir}" <<'PY'
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

task, run_dir = sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2])
paths = sorted(run_dir.glob("eval_outputs/Qwen__Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct/*_results.json"))
if not paths:
    raise SystemExit(1)
payload = json.loads(paths[-1].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
actual = int(payload["n-samples"][task]["effective"])
args = str(payload["config"].get("model_args", ""))
if actual != 200 or "method=fullkv" not in args or "flash_attention_2" not in args:
    raise SystemExit(1)
results = payload["results"][task]
metric = "WUPS,none" if task == "nextqa_oe_test" else "vatex_CIDEr,none"
if not math.isfinite(float(results[metric])):
    raise SystemExit(1)
samples = sorted(run_dir.glob(f"eval_outputs/Qwen__Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct/*_samples_{task}.jsonl"))
if not samples or sum(1 for _ in samples[-1].open(encoding="utf-8")) != 200:
    raise SystemExit(1)
print(f"[FullKV-200] validated task={task} samples=200 metric={metric} value={results[metric]:.6f}")
print(f"[FullKV-200] result={paths[-1]}")
PY
}

run_task() {
  local task=$1
  local port=$2
  local run_dir="${artifact_root}/scripts/logs/${task}/fullkv/64/qwen2_5_vl_7b/${run_tag}"
  mkdir -p "${run_dir}/eval_outputs"

  if validate_result "${task}" "${run_dir}" >"${run_dir}/validation.log" 2>&1; then
    cat "${run_dir}/validation.log"
    echo "[FullKV-200] skip completed task=${task}"
    return
  fi

  echo "[FullKV-200] start task=${task} at $(date -u '+%F %T UTC')"
  (
    cd "${opensource_root}"
    env \
      PYTHONPATH="${opensource_root}:${opensource_root}/csrc:${opensource_root}/lmms-eval" \
      METHOD=fullkv \
      MODEL_TYPE=qwen2_5_vl-7b \
      accelerate launch --num_processes 1 --main_process_port "${port}" -m lmms_eval \
        --model qwen2_5_vl \
        --model_args "pretrained=Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct,max_num_frames=64,attn_implementation=flash_attention_2,method=fullkv" \
        --tasks "${task}" \
        --batch_size 1 \
        --log_samples \
        --log_samples_suffix qwen7b_fullkv_limit200 \
        --output_path "${run_dir}/eval_outputs" \
        --gen_kwargs temperature=0 \
        --limit "${limit}"
  ) >"${run_dir}/run.log" 2>&1

  validate_result "${task}" "${run_dir}" | tee "${run_dir}/validation.log"
  echo "[FullKV-200] done task=${task} at $(date -u '+%F %T UTC')"
}

echo "[FullKV-200] queue started at $(date -u '+%F %T UTC')"
run_task vatex_test 55521
run_task nextqa_oe_test 55522
echo "[FullKV-200] queue completed at $(date -u '+%F %T UTC')"
